anchor.add.description: Creates a named text anchor (hyperlink destination) at the insertion point.

anchor.list.description: Lists the text anchors with their ids, names, stories, positions and pages.

anchored.insert.description: Anchors objects in a story at a text position, inline or above line, with offsets.

anchored.list.description: Lists anchored objects with their story, position and size.

anchored.options.description: Changes an anchored object's position and offsets.

anchored.release.description: Releases an anchored object back onto the page.

arrange.reorder.description: Moves objects to a place in the stacking order among a layer's objects on their spread (0 is the frontmost), onto that layer, as dragging their rows in the Layers panel does.

index.description: the place among the layer's objects, from the front (0 = frontmost)

layer.description: layer id (default: the first object's layer)

article.add.description: Appends objects to an article in order.

article.delete.description: Deletes an article; its objects stay.

article.list.description: Lists the articles (export reading-order groups) with their items.

article.new.description: Creates an article from objects (default: the selection); answers its name.

article.options.description: Renames an article, sets whether it exports, or reorders its items.

book.add.description: Adds a document to the book, optionally at an index.

book.exportPdf.description: Exports every document of the book in order as one PDF.

book.list.description: Answers the book: its path, style source and documents with their page counts and first pages.

book.new.description: Creates an empty book file (.dcbook) at a path.

book.open.description: Opens a book file and answers its documents.

book.paginate.description: Renumbers the book's documents so each starts where the previous one ended.

book.remove.description: Removes the document at an index from the book.

book.styleSource.description: Makes the document at an index the book's style source.

book.syncStyles.description: Copies the style source's paragraph and character styles and swatches into every document of the book.

bookmark.add.description: Adds a PDF bookmark for a page (1-based).

bookmark.delete.description: Deletes a PDF bookmark by index.

bookmark.rename.description: Renames a PDF bookmark by index.

button.clear.description: Turns buttons back into ordinary objects.

button.list.description: Lists the buttons with their ids, names and actions.

button.set.description: Turns objects into buttons that go to a page, the first, last, next or previous page, or a URL.

change.accept.description: Accepts the tracked change at a story position.

change.acceptAll.description: Accepts every tracked change (in one story or all).

change.list.description: Lists tracked changes with their story, position, kind (inserted or deleted) and text.

change.reject.description: Rejects the tracked change at a story position.

change.rejectAll.description: Rejects every tracked change (in one story or all).

change.track.description: Turns Track Changes in stories on or off; without on it toggles.

color.convert.description: Converts a colour between RGB, CMYK and gray with the working profiles; changes nothing.

color.description: {model: rgb, r, g, b} or {model: cmyk, c, m, y, k}

color.loadProfile.description: Loads an ICC profile from a path for use as a working space or proof target.

color.settings.description: Sets the working RGB and CMYK profiles and the rendering intent.

condition.apply.description: Applies a condition to the selected text, or removes it.

condition.delete.description: Deletes a condition; the text it was applied to stays and shows.

condition.list.description: Lists the conditional-text conditions with their colours and visibility.

condition.new.description: Creates a condition with a colour and visibility; answers its name.

condition.options.description: Renames a condition or changes its colour or visibility.

conveyor.clear.description: Removes every item from the conveyor.

conveyor.collect.description: Puts objects (default: the selection) onto the Content Collector conveyor.

conveyor.list.description: Lists the items on the conveyor.

conveyor.place.description: Places an item from the conveyor on a spread, keeping it on the conveyor when asked.

oneOf.description: a spread reference such as {kind: doc, index: 0}

data.fields.description: Answers data fields (name, kind, uses) from inline data or the linked source.

data.merge.description: Creates a merged document from data and the template with the merge options.

data.options.description: Sets data merge options: records, layout per page, spacing, insets and image fitting.

data.placeholder.add.description: Inserts a data field placeholder (text, image, QR or hyperlink) in a story or on an item.

data.preview.description: Fills the template with one record for preview, for this session only.

output.description: the record shown and the fields filled

data.preview.stop.description: Restores the unfilled template after a preview.

data.source.remove.description: Removes the data merge source; placeholders stay.

data.source.select.description: Selects a data merge source (CSV or spreadsheet by path or bytes) and answers its fields and records.

data.source.update.description: Re-reads the linked data merge source.

file.applyTemplate.description: Replaces the document's pages, parents and styles with a starter template (editorial, event, sale, quote).

file.history.description: Answers the undo and redo history.

file.inspect.description: Answers the document's structure: pages, spreads, items with ids, stories with overset, styles, swatches and the selection. Use story.get for text.

file.list.description: Lists the open documents with their indexes.

file.preferences.description: Sets document preferences: units, keyboard increments, guide colours, glyph fallback and black overprint.

edit.delete.description: Deletes the selected items (or the given ids), or the selected text.

edit.copy.description: Copies the selection; for selected text it answers the text with its formatting.

edit.cut.description: Cuts the selection to the clipboard.

edit.deselectAll.description: Clears the selection; no object stays selected.

edit.duplicate.description: Duplicates the selected objects, offset from the originals.

edit.paste.description: Pastes the clipboard (or given text), optionally in place at the copied position.

text.description: text to paste instead of the clipboard

edit.pasteInPlace.description: Pastes the copied objects at their original positions.

edit.pasteInto.description: Pastes the copied objects into the selected frame as its content, clipped by it.

edit.pasteWithoutFormatting.description: Pastes plain text at the insertion point in the formatting there.

edit.redo.description: Redoes the last undone step of the caller's own scope.

edit.selectAll.description: Selects all items on the active spreads, or all text when editing a story.

edit.stepAndRepeat.description: Makes copies of the selection a number of times at a dx, dy offset, or as a grid of rows and columns.

edit.transparencyBlendSpace.description: Sets the colour space (CMYK or RGB) transparency is composited in for output.

edit.undo.description: Undoes the last step of the caller's own scope (an agent undoes its own edits, not the person's).

endnote.delete.description: Deletes an endnote's reference and text, by its story and id.

endnote.edit.description: Replaces an endnote's text, by its story and id.

endnote.insert.description: Inserts an endnote reference at the insertion point with its text; the first one creates the endnote frame.

endnote.list.description: Lists the endnotes in numbering order with their story, id, number and text.

endnote.options.description: Sets endnote numbering style, start, prefix and suffix, heading and styles.

file.activate.description: Makes the open document at an index the active one.

file.close.description: Closes the open document (or the one at an index).

file.exportBytes.description: Answers the document as a PDF, PNG, JPEG, HTML, IDML or EPUB file in base64 without writing it; the host writes it as a new file.

file.exportEpub.description: Exports a reflowable EPUB with title, author, language and cover, to a path or as base64.

file.exportFixedEpub.description: Exports a fixed-layout (pre-paginated) EPUB, to a path or as base64.

file.exportHtml.description: Exports one self-contained HTML page with inline styles and embedded images.

file.exportIdml.description: Writes the document as an IDML package to a path, or answers it as base64.

file.exportImage.description: Exports pages (default all) as PNG or JPEG images at a resolution, to a folder or as base64.

file.exportPdf.description: Exports pages (default all) to PDF with a preset, marks and bleed, to a path or as base64.

oneOf.description: which printer's marks: crop, bleed, pageInfo, weight, offset

file.exportText.description: Exports a story's text as plain text, RTF or Tagged Text.

file.exportXml.description: Exports the tagged content as XML, to a path or as text.

file.importXml.description: Imports XML, putting each element's content into the next frame with that tag.

file.new.description: Replaces the open document with a new one from a page preset or size, with page count, facing pages, columns, gutter, margins and bleed.

file.newSample.description: Replaces the open document with a multi-page magazine sample, useful for trying commands.

file.open.description: Opens a .klayout or .idml file from a path; fonts in a Document Fonts folder beside it load too.

file.openBytes.description: Opens a document from base64 bytes (Kition Layout JSON or an IDML package) under a name.

file.openIdml.description: Opens an IDML package (path or base64) as a new document.

file.package.description: Packages the document into a new folder with its fonts, links, and optionally IDML, PDF and instructions.

file.place.description: Places a graphic or text file (by path or base64) on a spread or into a frame, at a position and size, with the page of a PDF.

spread.description: the spread (default spread 0); one that names no spread is refused

oneOf.description: a spread reference {kind: doc|parent, index} (parent spreads counted from 0)
a parent spread's prefix or label, such as A or A-Parent

file.presets.description: Lists the document presets (page sizes and settings) that file.new accepts.

file.print.description: Prints pages or spreads to a printer with copies, marks and bleed; dryRun only answers what would print.

file.printBooklet.description: Exports printer spreads for a booklet (saddle stitch or two-up) as PDF.

file.printers.description: Lists the printers and the default one.

file.recovery.list.description: Lists unsaved documents a crash left in the recovery folder, with their paths and titles.

file.recovery.open.description: Reopens the documents left in the recovery folder, unsaved.

file.recovery.save.description: Writes every unsaved document to the recovery folder.

file.render.description: Renders a preview of the layout as a PNG, without changing it: the whole canvas, one page, one spread, or one object (a diagnostic's target); answers {png, width, height}.

scale.description: device pixels per point, at most 2 (default 1)

maxSize.description: at most this many pixels on the longer side

target.description: the part to draw, as a diagnostic's target names it: an object ({path: "item:<id>"}, an id layout_inspect lists), a page ({page}, counted from 1) or a spread ({spread}, counted from 0); without it, the whole canvas

slide.description: a page counted from 0, when there is no target

file.revert.description: Throws away unsaved changes and reloads the last saved version; this cannot be undone.

file.save.description: Saves the document to its path, or to the given path, as .klayout.

file.saveACopy.description: Writes a copy of the document to a path without changing which file it is or its unsaved state.

file.saveAs.description: Saves the document under a new path, which becomes its path.

file.serialize.description: Answers the whole document as .klayout bytes in base64, without writing a file.

edit.replace.description: Replaces every match of text (or a GREP pattern) with new text, in a scope; answers how many changed.

edit.replaceObjects.description: Finds objects by criteria and changes their fill, stroke, weight or opacity; answers how many changed.

edit.find.description: Finds text (or a GREP pattern) in the document, a story or the selection and answers every match with its story and byte offsets; changes nothing.

edit.findNext.description: Selects the next match of a text after the caret.

edit.findObjects.description: Finds and selects objects by fill, stroke, weight, opacity and kind; answers their ids.

font.families.description: Lists the font families text can be set in, or one family's styles.

font.list.description: Lists the fonts used in the document with the characters set in them and whether any are missing.

font.replace.description: Replaces a font family and style in text (and styles, unless told not to) with another.

footnote.delete.description: Deletes a footnote's reference and text.

footnote.goToReference.description: Moves the caret from footnote text to just after its reference.

footnote.insert.description: Inserts a footnote reference at the insertion point with its text; the caret moves into the footnote.

footnote.list.description: Lists footnotes in story order with their story, id, anchor and text.

footnote.options.description: Sets footnote numbering, styles, spacing and layout options.

footnote.setText.description: Replaces a footnote's text, by its story and id.

form.clear.description: Turns form fields back into ordinary objects.

form.list.description: Lists the form fields with their ids, kinds, names, values and options.

form.set.description: Turns objects into form fields (text field, check box, combo box, list box, signature) with name, value and options.

frame.add.description: Creates a frame on a spread from a rectangle [x0, y0, x1, y1] in spread coordinates, with a shape and content type (graphic, text, unassigned); answers its id.

spread.description: the spread (default spread 0); one that names no spread is refused

oneOf.description: a spread reference {kind: doc|parent, index} (parent spreads counted from 0)
a parent spread's prefix or label, such as A or A-Parent

frame.fitText.description: Shrinks the text of text frames until it fits without overset, down to a minimum size.

frame.grid.description: Creates a grid of frames filling a rectangle with columns, rows and a gutter.

shape.description: a frame shape such as rectangle or ellipse

oneOf.description: a spread reference such as {kind: doc, index: 0}

frame.loadText.description: Loads the text cursor from a text frame's out port (or in port) to continue its story elsewhere.

frame.description: an object id from file.inspect or object.list

frame.thread.description: Threads a text frame's story into another frame (or a new frame drawn on a spread).

from.description: an object id from file.inspect or object.list

spread.description: the spread (default spread 0, for frame.thread the source frame's spread); one that names no spread is refused

oneOf.description: a spread reference {kind: doc|parent, index} (parent spreads counted from 0)
a parent spread's prefix or label, such as A or A-Parent

to.description: an object id from file.inspect or object.list

frame.unthread.description: Breaks a text frame's thread after it (or before it); the following frames lose the story.

frame.description: an object id from file.inspect or object.list

gap.move.description: Moves the gap between objects at a point (Gap tool), resizing the objects beside it.

spread.description: the spread (default spread 0); one that names no spread is refused

oneOf.description: a spread reference {kind: doc|parent, index} (parent spreads counted from 0)
a parent spread's prefix or label, such as A or A-Parent

guide.add.description: Adds a horizontal or vertical guide at a position on a spread or page.

oneOf.description: a spread reference such as {kind: doc, index: 0}

guide.delete.description: Deletes a guide by page and index.

oneOf.description: a spread reference such as {kind: doc, index: 0}

guide.deleteAll.description: Deletes every guide on a spread.

oneOf.description: a spread reference such as {kind: doc, index: 0}

guide.liquid.description: Makes a guide a liquid guide, or not.

spread.description: the spread (default spread 0); one that names no spread is refused

oneOf.description: a spread reference {kind: doc|parent, index} (parent spreads counted from 0)
a parent spread's prefix or label, such as A or A-Parent

guide.list.description: Lists the guides on a spread with their orientation and position.

oneOf.description: a spread reference such as {kind: doc, index: 0}

guide.move.description: Moves a guide to a new position.

oneOf.description: a spread reference such as {kind: doc, index: 0}

layer.duplicate.description: Duplicates a layer with a copy of each of its objects, just above it.

link.add.description: Creates a hyperlink from the selected text or objects to a URL, email or page.

link.edit.description: Changes a hyperlink's name or destination.

link.goToSource.description: Selects a hyperlink's text or frame.

link.list.description: Lists the hyperlinks with their ids, names and destinations.

hyphenation.addException.description: Adds a hyphenation exception: breaks only at ~, or never for a word without ~.

index.addReference.description: Adds an index page reference for topics (default: the selected text) or a see/see also reference.

index.generate.description: Generates an index with a title, section headings and run-in option in a new frame.

index.list.description: Lists the index page references with their topics and pages.

ink.list.description: Answers the inks: whether each spot ink prints as process, and its alias.

ink.options.description: Sets ink options: all to process, one ink to process, or an ink alias.

layer.activate.description: Makes a layer the active layer for new objects.

layer.delete.description: Deletes a layer and its objects.

layer.deleteUnused.description: Deletes layers without objects (one layer always stays).

layer.merge.description: Merges layers into one, moving their objects.

layer.move.description: Moves a layer to a position (0 is the top).

layer.new.description: Creates a layer; answers its id.

layer.others.description: Hides or locks every layer but one, or shows or unlocks all.

layer.selectItems.description: Selects every object on a layer.

layer.set.description: Sets a layer's name, visibility, lock, printing and colour.

layout.addAlternate.description: Creates an alternate layout of the pages at a new size, with a page rule.

rule.description: a page rule such as scale or reCenter

layout.addGuides.description: Creates rows and columns of guides with gutters, fitted to the margins or the page.

oneOf.description: a spread reference such as {kind: doc, index: 0}

layout.deleteAlternate.description: Deletes an alternate layout's pages and parents.

layout.detachAll.description: Detaches a page's overridden copies from the parent, making them ordinary items.

layout.documentSetup.description: Sets the document's page size, page count, start page, facing pages, binding, bleed and slug.

layout.list.description: Lists the layouts with their first page, page count and size.

layout.overrideParentItems.description: Overrides parent items on a page (0-based) so they can be edited there; answers the copies' ids.

layout.pageSize.description: Sets the size of chosen pages (1-based) from a preset or width and height.

layout.pages.applyParent.description: Applies a parent spread to pages, or none.

pages.description: page numbers, counted from 1 as layout.section and frame.thread count them

layout.pages.duplicateSpread.description: Duplicates a spread with its items.

oneOf.description: a spread reference such as {kind: doc, index: 0}

layout.pages.insert.description: Inserts pages after a page (default: the last) with a parent.

after.description: a page counted from 0; default: the last

layout.pages.move.description: Moves a page from one index to another.

layout.pages.toSpread.description: Adds a page (1-based) to a spread (0-based).

oneOf.description: a spread reference such as {kind: doc, index: 0}

layout.parents.edit.description: Shows or hides parent spreads on the canvas for editing.

layout.parents.new.description: Creates a parent spread with a prefix and name.

layout.removeOverrides.description: Deletes a page's overridden parent copies so the parent items show again.

layout.rotateSpreadView.description: Rotates the view of one spread by 90, -90 or 180 degrees, or clears it; output is unchanged.

layout.section.description: Starts a section at a page (1-based) with a start number, numbering style and marker.

oneOf.description: the page number the section starts at; null continues

layout.spreadShuffle.description: Allows or stops a spread's pages shuffling apart when pages are added or removed.

oneOf.description: a spread reference such as {kind: doc, index: 0}

library.add.description: Adds the selection to the library as an item; answers its index.

library.json.description: Answers the library as JSON text, to save where there is no file system.

library.list.description: Lists the library's items with their indexes, names and descriptions.

library.new.description: Creates an empty object library, saved to a path when given.

library.open.description: Opens an object library from a path or JSON and answers its items.

library.place.description: Places a library item on a spread at its original position or at x, y.

oneOf.description: a spread reference such as {kind: doc, index: 0}

library.remove.description: Deletes a library item by index.

line.add.description: Creates a straight line between two points on a spread; answers its id.

spread.description: the spread (default spread 0); one that names no spread is refused

oneOf.description: a spread reference {kind: doc|parent, index} (parent spreads counted from 0)
a parent spread's prefix or label, such as A or A-Parent

linkedFile.copyTo.description: Copies placed files to a folder and relinks the document to the copies.

linkedFile.embed.description: Embeds a linked graphic in the document.

linkedFile.goTo.description: Selects the frames showing a linked graphic.

linkedFile.list.description: Lists placed graphics' links with their status (ok, modified, missing, embedded), size and uses.

linkedFile.relink.description: Points every placement of a graphic at another file.

linkedFile.relinkFolder.description: Relinks graphics to files of the same name in a folder, optionally with another extension.

extension.description: a file extension such as tif

linkedFile.unembed.description: Keeps an embedded graphic in a file and links it there (Unembed Link).

linkedFile.update.description: Reloads modified links from their files (one or all).

liquid.object.description: Sets objects' liquid layout constraints: resize and pin to edges.

liquid.pageRule.description: Sets the liquid layout rule (scale, re-centre, guide or object based) for pages.

list.define.description: Defines or renames a named list that numbered paragraphs can join across stories.

math.insert.description: Inserts a math expression typeset from LaTeX at the text insertion point or at a position.

spread.description: the spread (default spread 0); one that names no spread is refused

oneOf.description: a spread reference {kind: doc|parent, index} (parent spreads counted from 0)
a parent spread's prefix or label, such as A or A-Parent

math.svg.description: Typesets a LaTeX expression and answers its SVG and size without placing it.

media.get.description: Answers a media object's kind, name and playback options.

media.options.description: Sets placed media options: play on page load, loop, controls and poster.

note.convertToText.description: Turns a note into ordinary story text in place of its anchor.

note.delete.description: Deletes an editorial note by its story and id.

note.edit.description: Changes a note's text or author.

note.list.description: Lists the notes in story order with their position, author and text.

note.new.description: Adds an editorial note (not printed) with text and author at the insertion point; answers its story and id.

object.align.description: Aligns objects' edges or centres to each other, the key object, the margins, the page or the spread.

object.altText.description: Sets the alternative text of objects for tagged PDF and EPUB.

object.arrange.description: Moves objects to the front, forward, backward or to the back of the stacking order.

object.attributes.description: Sets objects' print attributes: overprint fill, stroke and gap, and non-printing.

object.bevel.description: Turns bevel and emboss on or off with size, depth, angle, highlight and shadow.

arrange.bringForward.description: Brings the selection one step forward.

arrange.bringToFront.description: Brings the selection to the front.

object.caption.description: Generates a static caption below objects from a template with variables such as {name} and {altText}.

object.clippingPath.description: Makes a clipping path for a placed graphic from its alpha channel or detected edges, with a threshold.

object.color.description: Applies a colour (hex, CMYK or RGB) to objects' fill or stroke without making a swatch.

object.content.description: Sets what a frame holds: graphic, text or unassigned.

object.convertShape.description: Converts objects to another shape (rectangle, rounded rectangle, ellipse, triangle, polygon, line…).

object.cornerOptions.description: Sets objects' corner shape (rounded, inverse rounded, inset, bevel, fancy) and size.

object.directionalFeather.description: Turns a directional feather on or off with widths per side.

object.distribute.description: Distributes objects horizontally or vertically by centres or by equal spacing.

object.dropShadow.description: Turns a drop shadow on or off and sets its distance, angle, opacity, size, spread and colour.

oneOf.description: a spread reference such as {kind: doc, index: 0}

object.exportOptions.description: Sets objects' export options: tagged-PDF artifact, rasterising for EPUB and HTML, alignment.

object.feather.description: Sets a basic feather width on objects (0 turns it off).

object.fill.description: Sets objects' fill to a swatch with a tint from 0 to 1.

object.findByLabel.description: Answers the ids of objects whose script label equals a text.

object.fit.description: Fits a frame's graphic: fill or fit proportionally, fit content to frame, centre, or frame to content.

object.fittingOptions.description: Sets a frame's fitting options: auto-fit, fitting, alignment reference and crop amounts.

object.globalLight.description: Sets the light angle shared by effects that use global light.

object.gradient.description: Applies a linear or radial gradient with colour stops to objects' fill or stroke.

object.gradientFeather.description: Turns a gradient feather on or off, linear or radial, with angle and start and end opacity.

arrange.group.description: Groups objects (default: the selection) into one group.

object.hide.description: Hides objects; they stay in the document.

object.innerGlow.description: Turns an inner glow on or off and sets its opacity, size, choke, source and colour.

object.innerShadow.description: Turns an inner shadow on or off and sets its distance, angle, opacity, size, choke and colour.

object.label.description: Sets a free-text script label on objects so scripts and agents can find them with object.findByLabel.

object.layerOptions.description: Hides layers of placed PDFs by name.

object.lock.description: Locks objects so they cannot be selected or changed on the canvas.

object.makeCompoundPath.description: Joins the selected paths into one compound path with the backmost object's look.

object.matchAttributes.description: Copies fill, stroke, corners, opacity, effects and wrap from one object to others, like the eyedropper; with a point, a placed graphic's colour there or the text formatting there.

point.description: [x, y] in points on the spread

target.description: with point on a placed graphic: the colour goes to the fill or the stroke

object.opacity.description: Sets objects' opacity from 0 to 1 and blend mode.

object.outerGlow.description: Turns an outer glow on or off and sets its opacity, size, spread and colour.

oneOf.description: a spread reference such as {kind: doc, index: 0}

object.pathfinder.description: Combines the selected shapes by add, subtract, intersect, exclude or minus back.

object.pdfLayers.description: Lists the layers of the selected placed PDF with their visibility.

object.primaryTextFrame.description: Makes the selected text frame's story the primary text frame, or turns that off.

object.qrCode.description: Generates a QR code object for a URL, text, SMS, email or vCard.

spread.description: the spread (default spread 0); one that names no spread is refused

oneOf.description: a spread reference {kind: doc|parent, index} (parent spreads counted from 0)
a parent spread's prefix or label, such as A or A-Parent

object.releaseCompoundPath.description: Splits a compound path so each subpath becomes its own object; answers their ids.

object.satin.description: Turns a satin effect on or off with opacity, angle, distance, size and colour.

arrange.sendBackward.description: Sends the selection one step backward.

arrange.sendToBack.description: Sends the selection to the back.

object.setFlags.description: Sets objects' hidden and locked flags, as the Layers panel's eye and lock do.

object.showAll.description: Shows every hidden object on the spread.

object.stroke.description: Sets objects' stroke: swatch, tint, weight, alignment, stroke type, caps and joins, gap colour.

object.textFrameOptions.description: Sets text frames' columns, gutter, insets, vertical justification, first baseline, auto-size and column rules.

object.textWrap.description: Sets how text wraps around objects (bounding box, contour, jump object, jump to next column) and the offset.

object.transparencyGroup.description: Sets isolate blending and knockout group on groups.

arrange.ungroup.description: Splits groups back into their objects.

object.unlockAll.description: Unlocks every locked object on the spread.

page.background.description: Sets the page background colour (hex or swatch), or none for transparent.

page.transition.description: Sets a page transition (blinds, box, dissolve…) for pages, a spread, or all.

page.transitions.description: Lists the page transitions by spread.

path.addAnchor.description: Adds an anchor point on a path at the nearest point to a position.

path.appendAnchor.description: Adds an anchor point with handles at the end of a path.

path.convertAnchor.description: Converts an anchor point between corner and smooth, or drags out symmetric handles to a point.

path.add.description: Creates a path from anchor points with optional handles, open or closed; answers its id.

spread.description: the spread (default spread 0); one that names no spread is refused

oneOf.description: a spread reference {kind: doc|parent, index} (parent spreads counted from 0)
a parent spread's prefix or label, such as A or A-Parent

path.deleteAnchor.description: Deletes an anchor point of a path by subpath and anchor index (0-based); the object goes when no path is left.

path.erase.description: Erases the part of a path the drag points cross, as the Erase tool does.

path.moveAnchors.description: Moves anchor points (or their handles) of a path by dx, dy.

path.smooth.description: Smooths a path along the drag points, re-fitting fewer anchors.

path.split.description: Cuts a path at the nearest point to a position (Scissors), opening it or splitting it in two.

place.drop.description: Places the loaded graphic at a point, into a rectangle, or into a frame.

spread.description: the spread (default spread 0); one that names no spread is refused

oneOf.description: a spread reference {kind: doc|parent, index} (parent spreads counted from 0)
a parent spread's prefix or label, such as A or A-Parent

place.load.description: Loads a graphic into the place cursor so place.drop puts it on the page.

queue.description: add it behind the graphics already loaded: each click places the next

place.styles.description: Reads a document's paragraph and character styles before importing them, listing the names and conflicts; changes nothing.

preflight.run.description: Checks the document for output problems (missing fonts and links, low-resolution images, overset text…) and answers the issues.

prefs.set.description: Sets application preferences: hidden characters, typographer's quotes, polygon sides, stroke scaling and more.

script.run.description: Runs a command script (lines of command ids with JSON parameters, or a JSON array) as one undo step.

select.container.description: Selects the group or frame that holds the selection.

select.content.description: Selects the graphic inside a frame, or the first object in a group.

select.firstAbove.description: Selects the frontmost object on the spread.

select.lastBelow.description: Selects the backmost object on the spread.

select.nextAbove.description: Selects the next object above the selection in the stacking order.

select.nextBelow.description: Selects the next object below the selection in the stacking order.

select.nextInGroup.description: Selects the next object in the selection's group.

select.previousInGroup.description: Selects the previous object in the selection's group.

select.set.description: Selects objects by id, adding to the selection or selecting their content when asked.

key.description: the key object Align aligns to: one of the selected objects; null drops it

select.toggle.description: Adds an object to the selection, or removes it if it is selected.

snippet.export.description: Exports the selected items with their stories, styles and images as a .klayout snippet, to a path or as base64.

snippet.place.description: Places a snippet's items on a spread, at their own positions unless x and y are given.

spread.description: the spread (default spread 0); one that names no spread is refused

oneOf.description: a spread reference {kind: doc|parent, index} (parent spreads counted from 0)
a parent spread's prefix or label, such as A or A-Parent

spelling.addWord.description: Adds a word to the document's user dictionary.

spelling.change.description: Replaces a misspelled word at a story range.

spelling.check.description: Checks spelling in a story or the document and answers misspelled words with positions and suggestions.

spelling.setWords.description: Replaces the document's user dictionary with a word list.

spelling.words.description: Lists the words in the document's user dictionary.

state.add.description: Turns objects (or one group's objects) into a multi-state object.

state.list.description: Lists a multi-state object's states and the active one.

state.release.description: Releases a multi-state object back to a plain group.

state.rename.description: Renames a state of a multi-state object.

state.show.description: Shows one state of a multi-state object by index or name.

story.get.description: Answers a story's text, frames, paragraphs, direction and whether it is overset; the way to read text.

story.links.description: Lists linked stories with their parents and whether they are out of date.

story.placeAndLink.description: Places a linked copy of a story in a new frame; the copy follows the parent when updated.

spread.description: the spread (default spread 0); one that names no spread is refused

oneOf.description: a spread reference {kind: doc|parent, index} (parent spreads counted from 0)
a parent spread's prefix or label, such as A or A-Parent

story.replaceRange.description: Replaces a byte range of a story's text, keeping the surrounding formatting.

story.setDirection.description: Sets a story's column progression to left to right or right to left.

story.setText.description: Replaces a story's whole text; the story is found by its id from file.inspect.

story.unlink.description: Unlinks a story from its parent.

story.updateLink.description: Updates linked stories (default: every out-of-date one) from their parents.

strokeStyle.delete.description: Deletes a stroke style; strokes using it become solid.

strokeStyle.list.description: Lists the stroke styles with their kinds.

strokeStyle.new.description: Creates a stroke style of stripes, dashes or dots.

style.breakLink.description: Keeps the selected text's look as local formatting and detaches it from its paragraph or character style.

style.cell.apply.description: Applies a cell style to the target cells, or the whole table.

style.cell.add.description: Creates a table cell style with fill, tint, insets and paragraph style, or from the target cell.

style.cell.edit.description: Changes a cell style; cells using it follow.

style.character.apply.description: Applies a character style to the selected text.

style.character.add.description: Creates a character style based on another, setting only the given attributes.

style.character.delete.description: Deletes a character style, replacing it in text with another (default [None]).

style.character.edit.description: Changes a character style's name, base style and attributes; null removes an attribute.

style.compositeFont.set.description: Creates or replaces a composite font: per character set, a family, style, relative size and scale.

style.exportTag.description: Sets the HTML or EPUB tag and class a style exports as.

style.group.description: Moves paragraph or character styles into a style group.

style.list.description: Lists the paragraph and character style names.

style.object.apply.description: Applies an object style to objects.

style.object.add.description: Creates an object style from the selection or with a fill and paragraph style.

style.paragraph.apply.description: Applies a paragraph style to the selected paragraphs, clearing local overrides when asked.

style.paragraph.add.description: Creates a paragraph style based on another, with paragraph and character attributes or from the selection.

style.paragraph.delete.description: Deletes a paragraph style, replacing it in text with another.

style.paragraph.edit.description: Changes a paragraph style's name, base style, next style and attributes; text using it follows.

style.table.apply.description: Applies a table style to a table.

style.table.add.description: Creates a table style with cell styles for header, body, footer and columns, and borders.

style.table.edit.description: Changes a table style; tables using it follow.

swatch.addToSwatches.description: Adds a colour (default: the selection's fill) to the swatches under a new name.

swatch.addUnnamed.description: Turns every unnamed colour in use into a swatch.

swatch.add.description: Creates a colour swatch from hex, CMYK (0 to 100) or RGB, process or spot.

swatch.load.description: Loads colour swatches from an .ase file, replacing the existing ones when asked.

swatch.moveToGroup.description: Moves swatches into a colour group, or to the top level with null.

swatch.newColorGroup.description: Creates a colour group in the Swatches panel and moves swatches into it.

swatch.save.description: Saves colour swatches to an .ase file or as base64.

swatch.ungroupColorGroup.description: Removes a colour group, moving its swatches to the top level.

table.convertFromText.description: Converts the selected paragraphs into a table, splitting columns at tabs or commas.

table.convertToText.description: Converts the table at the caret into tab-separated paragraphs.

table.delete.description: Deletes the table at the caret.

table.deleteColumn.description: Deletes the columns of the target cells.

table.deleteRow.description: Deletes the rows of the target cells.

table.distributeColumns.description: Gives the selected columns equal widths.

table.dropCells.description: Moves selected whole rows or columns by dragging them from one point to another.

table.get.description: Answers a table's rows, columns and cells (text, spans, fill) and options.

table.insert.description: Creates a table at the text insertion point with body rows, columns, header and footer rows and width.

table.insertColumn.description: Inserts columns left or right of the target cell's column, with a width.

table.insertColumnLeft.description: Inserts columns to the left of the target cell's column.

table.insertColumnRight.description: Inserts columns to the right of the target cell's column.

table.insertRow.description: Inserts rows above or below the target cell's row.

table.insertRowAbove.description: Inserts rows above the target cell's row.

table.insertRowBelow.description: Inserts rows below the target cell's row.

table.merge.description: Merges the target cell range into one cell.

table.moveColumn.description: Moves a column (0-based; default the target column) to another position.

table.moveRow.description: Moves a row (0-based; default the target row) to another position.

table.nextCell.description: Moves to the next table cell.

table.options.description: Sets table options: direction, border, spacing before and after, header and footer rows and repeats, alternating fills.

table.placeGraphic.description: Turns the target cell into a graphic cell holding an image, fitted proportionally or to fill.

table.prevCell.description: Moves to the previous table cell.

table.select.description: Selects cells, rows, columns or a whole table by story, table and row and column ranges.

table.selectColumn.description: Selects the column at the caret.

table.selectRow.description: Selects the row at the caret.

table.selectTable.description: Selects the whole table at the caret.

table.setCell.description: Sets the target cells' fill, tint, insets, vertical justification and text.

table.resizeBorder.description: Moves a table's row or column border by a distance in points, as dragging it does; keepTableSize keeps the table's size.

index.description: the column or row the border ends, from 0

size.description: the column's width or the row's height to make, in points

table.setColumnWidth.description: Sets the target columns' width in points.

table.setRowHeight.description: Sets the target rows' height in points, at least or exactly.

table.sortRows.description: Sorts the body rows by a column (0-based; default the target cell's), ascending or descending.

table.splitHorizontally.description: Splits the target cell into two, one above the other.

table.splitVertically.description: Splits the target cell into two, side by side.

table.textCell.description: Turns graphic cells back into text cells.

template.list.description: Lists the starter layouts file.applyTemplate accepts, with their sizes.

text.delete.description: Deletes the selected text, or a character (or word) before or after the caret.

text.exitToFrame.description: Leaves text editing and selects the frame instead.

text.extendTo.description: Extends the text selection to a point in a frame.

unit.description: after text.selectWord with a unit: grow the selection by whole units of it

text.insert.description: Types text at the caret, replacing the selected text, with typographer's quotes unless raw.

text.insertSpecial.description: Inserts a special character at the caret, replacing the selected text: a marker the text shows in place (the number of the page it sits on, the next or previous page's, the section marker) or a break (column, frame, page, odd or even page, forced line) or Indent to Here or Right Indent Tab.

text.move.description: Moves the text caret left, right, up, down, or to the line or story start or end, optionally by words or extending the selection.

text.placeCaret.description: Puts the text caret in a frame at a point, turning an empty frame into a text frame.

text.release.description: Ends a press in text at a point: a drag moves or copies the selected text there.

text.select.description: Selects text in a story between two byte offsets, as edit.find reports them.

text.selectWord.description: Selects the word at a point in a frame, or its line, paragraph or whole story (several clicks).

unit.description: word, line, paragraph or story: what two, three, four or five clicks select

toc.entries.description: Answers the table-of-contents entries for styles (level, text, page) without changing the document.

toc.generate.description: Generates a table of contents from paragraph styles with levels, a title and page numbers, in a new frame.

toc.update.description: Regenerates the existing table of contents.

tool.polygonSettings.description: Sets the number of sides and star inset new polygons use, and answers the settings.

tool.select.description: Selects an editor tool (selection, direct selection, type, frame…).

transform.again.description: Repeats the last transform (or sequence of transforms) on the selection.

transform.clear.description: Removes rotation, shear and scaling from objects, keeping their centre.

transform.info.description: Answers objects' scale, rotation and shear (and those of placed content).

content.description: measure the first target's placed graphic, not the frame

transform.move.description: Moves objects (default: the selection) by dx and dy points, optionally as a copy or to another spread.

oneOf.description: a spread reference such as {kind: doc, index: 0}

content.description: move each frame's placed graphic inside the frame, not the frame

transform.resize.description: Resizes objects from one rectangle to another, scaling content when asked.

transform.rotate.description: Rotates objects by an angle in degrees, counter-clockwise, about their centre.

transform.scale.description: Scales objects by sx and sy about the selection centre.

transform.set.description: Sets objects' position, size, scale, rotation and shear exactly, as the Transform panel does.

content.description: size and place each frame's placed graphic, not the frame

bounds.description: with content: the graphic's box [x0, y0, x1, y1] on the spread

transform.shear.description: Shears objects by an angle in degrees.

text.align.description: Sets the alignment of the selected paragraphs by name.

format.alignLeft.description: Aligns the selected paragraphs to the left.

format.alignRight.description: Aligns the selected paragraphs to the right.

text.allCaps.description: Toggles all caps on the selected text.

format.bold.description: Toggles bold on the selected text.

text.changeCase.description: Changes the selected text (or selected frames' stories) to upper, lower, title or sentence case.

text.char.description: Sets character attributes on the selected text: font family and style, size, leading, tracking, colour and more.

text.convertToOutlines.description: Converts text frames into compound paths of their glyphs.

text.fillWithPlaceholder.description: Fills a text frame with placeholder text.

format.italic.description: Toggles italic on the selected text.

format.justify.description: Justifies the selected paragraphs with the last line aligned left.

text.kenten.description: Turns emphasis dots (kenten) on the selected characters on or off.

text.onPath.description: Puts text on a path, with a start distance, flip and alignment.

start.description: distance along the path in points

text.openType.description: Turns an OpenType feature (ligatures, fractions, ordinals, swashes, stylistic sets…) on or off for the selected text.

text.para.description: Sets paragraph attributes on the selected paragraphs: alignment, indents, spacing, drop caps and more.

text.pathOptions.description: Changes type on a path's start, flip and alignment, or removes it.

text.ruby.description: Sets the ruby reading over the selected text; empty text removes it.

text.selectionAttrs.description: Answers the resolved character and paragraph attributes at the text selection.

format.decreaseFontSize.description: Decreases the selected text's point size by one step.

format.increaseFontSize.description: Increases the selected text's point size by one step.

text.storyDirection.description: Makes the stories of the text selection or selected frames vertical or horizontal.

text.tateChuYoko.description: Sets the selected text horizontally within a vertical line (tate-chu-yoko), or not.

format.underline.description: Toggles underline on the selected text.

text.warichu.description: Turns warichu (inline split lines) on the selected text on or off, with lines, size, spacing and alignment.

variable.define.description: Defines a text variable (custom, last page number, chapter number, file name, dates, running header…).

variable.delete.description: Deletes a text variable; its instances become plain text.

variable.insert.description: Inserts a text variable at the text insertion point.

variable.list.description: Lists the text variables with their types and values.

view.showTextThreads.description: Shows or hides the lines between threaded text frames in the editor.

xml.deleteTag.description: Deletes an XML tag; tagged objects are untagged.

xml.loadDtd.description: Loads a DTD for validation and adds a tag for each element it declares.

xml.mapStyle.description: Maps a paragraph style to an XML tag for export.

xml.newTag.description: Creates an XML tag with a colour.

xml.structure.description: Answers the XML structure in reading order: elements with tags, ids, kinds and text.

xml.tag.description: Tags frames (default: the selection) with an XML tag, creating it if new, or untags them.

xml.tagText.description: Tags the selected text as an inline element, or untags it.

xml.tags.description: Answers the XML tags, the style-to-tag map and whether a DTD is loaded.

xml.validate.description: Validates the XML structure against the loaded DTD and answers the problems.

xref.defineFormat.description: Defines a cross-reference format from building blocks such as <paraText /> and <pageNum />.

xref.formats.description: Lists the cross-reference formats with their definitions.

xref.insert.description: Inserts a cross-reference to a text anchor or paragraph in a format at the insertion point.

xref.list.description: Lists the cross-references with their position, target, format and text.
